newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO says reactor to resume operation this week.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO says reactor to resume operation this week.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Tuesday that its 784,000-kilowatt reactor in eastern Japan will resume operation around Thursday, after shutting down last week due to technical problems.
TEPCO's Fukushima No 1 nuclear reactor automatically shut down last Wednesday due to a lack of coolant supply to the reactor.

At the time the reactor -- located 228 km (143 miles) northeast of Tokyo -- was in the process of lowering operating rates in preparation for a maintenance closure which was due to to take roughly 10 days from Tuesday last week.
The incident has not affected TEPCO's maintenance work schedule and the reactor will resume operation around Thursday, in line with initial plans, a TEPCO spokesman said.
"(The malfunction) has been corrected and the maintenance closure will follow the initial schedule," a TEPCO spokesman said.
The technical problems at the reactor did not cause a radiation leakage.
